records.name: Bioyond 细胞培养工作站
records.description: Bioyond 细胞培养工作站，集成物料管理、调度控制和自动化上料功能，支持Excel批量导入和多仓库管理，适用于细胞培养实验的全流程自动化。

records.name: CBox驱动的Transmon超导量子比特
records.description: 一种通过微波脉冲、读出谐振腔和通量脉冲进行控制与测量的Transmon超导量子比特，并配合CBox电子学完成时序与采集。该器件常用于量子计算实验中的能谱测量、Rabi、T1、Ramsey、回波、单次读出、随机基准测试，以及通量脉冲和CZ相关相位表征。
records.description_en: A superconducting transmon qubit controlled and measured with microwave pulses, a readout resonator, and flux pulses, using CBox-based electronics for timing and acquisition. It is used in quantum computing experiments for spectroscopy, Rabi, T1, Ramsey, echo, single-shot readout, randomized benchmarking, and characterization of flux pulses and CZ-related phase behavior.

records.name: USB 摄像头控制器
records.description: Uni-Lab-OS 摄像头驱动（Linux USB 摄像头版，无 PTZ）

records.name: 晶圆探针台
records.description: 用于半导体晶圆电学测试的探针台，可精确定位晶圆与探针，在测试仪器配合下对晶圆上器件进行接触和测量，常用于参数表征、工艺开发与失效分析。
records.description_en: A wafer prober used for semiconductor wafer electrical testing. It precisely positions the wafer and probe needles so instruments can contact and measure on-wafer devices, commonly for device characterization, process development, and failure analysis.

records.name: 派能储能电池模组
records.description: 用于与派能储能锂电池模组或其电池管理系统通信，扫描总线上的电池模块，并读取协议版本、厂商信息、系统参数、管理信息、序列号及运行数值，适合实验室储能系统监测与集成。
records.description_en: Used to communicate with Pylontech energy storage battery modules or their battery management interface, scan battery modules on the bus, and read protocol version, manufacturer information, system parameters, management information, serial numbers, and operating values for laboratory energy storage monitoring and integration.

records.name: 通量可调超导量子比特
records.description: 一种工作于低温量子测量系统中的超导量子比特，可通过微波信号进行驱动与读出，并通过磁通偏置调谐到甜点或反甜点附近。该器件常用于连续波谱测、时域相干实验、磁通扫描、自动表征以及量子读出链优化。
records.description_en: A superconducting qubit used in low-temperature quantum measurement systems. It is controlled and read out with microwave signals and can be tuned with magnetic flux bias near sweet spots or anti-sweet spots. It is commonly used for continuous-wave spectroscopy, time-domain coherence experiments, flux tuning, automated characterization, and optimization of the qubit readout chain.

records.name: AMI超导磁体
records.description: AMI超导磁体用于实验中产生和稳定控制磁场，通常由磁体电源驱动，并基于电流与磁场换算关系进行设定与调节。该类设备常用于低温物理、量子器件与材料表征等需要高稳定外加磁场的场景。
records.description_en: An AMI superconducting magnet used to generate and stably control magnetic fields in experiments, typically driven by a magnet power supply and configured through a current-to-field conversion relationship. It is commonly used in scenarios requiring stable external fields, including cryogenic physics, quantum-device experiments, and materials characterization.

records.name: BACnet楼宇自动化控制器
records.description: 这是一类支持 BACnet 协议的楼宇自动化现场设备或控制器，常用于连接和管理暖通空调、环境传感器、执行器、电表、报警点位等。它可在网络中发布设备与对象信息，并允许读取或写入各类点位属性。在实验室或科研设施中，这类设备常用于房间环境监测、空调与通风联动、能耗采集以及楼宇基础设施集成。
records.description_en: This is a BACnet-compatible building automation field device or controller used to interface with HVAC equipment, environmental sensors, actuators, utility meters, and alarm points. It exposes device and object information on the network and allows properties of points to be read or written. In laboratories and research facilities, such devices are commonly used for room environmental monitoring, HVAC and ventilation coordination, energy data collection, and facility infrastructure integration.

records.name: CPU片上温度传感器
records.description: 集成在处理器芯片内部的温度传感器，用于读取CPU热区温度。在实验室和计算平台中可用于热管理、过温告警、散热评估，以及负载测试过程中的温升监测。
records.description_en: An integrated temperature sensor inside the processor used to read the CPU thermal-zone temperature. In laboratory and computing setups, it is used for thermal management, over-temperature alarms, cooling evaluation, and temperature-rise monitoring during load testing.

records.name: EIGER X射线探测器
records.description: EIGER 是一种混合像素光子计数型 X 射线面阵探测器，用于在同步辐射和实验室 X 射线实验中采集衍射或散射图像。
records.description_en: The EIGER is a hybrid-pixel photon-counting X-ray area detector used to acquire diffraction or scattering images in synchrotron and laboratory X-ray experiments.

records.name: EIGER X射线面探测器
records.description: EIGER 是一种像素化 X 射线面积探测器，用于采集实验中的二维衍射或散射图像，常见于同步辐射、晶体学及 X 射线散射测量等场景。
records.description_en: The EIGER is a pixelated X-ray area detector used to collect two-dimensional diffraction or scattering images in experiments, commonly in synchrotron, crystallography, and X-ray scattering applications.

records.name: EMCO/ETS 2090 位置控制器
records.description: 这是一种用于电磁兼容与天线测试系统的位置控制器，用于控制位置器或扫描机构的运动、目标位置、行程上下限以及垂直/水平极化切换。它常见于电波暗室或自动化测试平台中，用来驱动天线塔、扫描装置或类似运动平台完成定位与扫动。
records.description_en: This is a positioner controller used in EMC and antenna test systems to control motion, target position, travel limits, and vertical/horizontal polarization selection. It is commonly used in anechoic chambers or automated test setups to drive antenna masts, scanning mechanisms, or similar motion platforms for positioning and sweeps.

records.name: EPICS步进扫描控制组件
records.description: 用于实验自动化中的非物理软件组件，负责组织EPICS步进扫描流程。它可配置位置器、探测器、触发器、计数器和额外PV，执行逐点扫描、采集数据、处理暂停/中止、发布每点数据并写出扫描文件。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component for experiment automation that orchestrates EPICS step-scan workflows. It configures positioners, detectors, triggers, counters, and extra PVs, then executes point-by-point scans, acquires data, handles pause/abort logic, publishes per-point data, and writes scan output files.

records.name: Keithley 2400 / Lake Shore 350 联合实验控制组件
records.name_en: Keithley 2400 / Lake Shore 350 Experiment Control Component
records.description: 一个非物理软件组件，用于协调 Keithley 2400 源表与 Lake Shore 350 温控器的实验流程。它负责仪器连接、参数配置、温度读取、加热器量程与温度设定值设置、温度斜坡控制、电学测量读取，以及实验图形界面的创建、样式、日志和状态管理。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component that coordinates experiments involving a Keithley 2400 source meter and a Lake Shore 350 temperature controller. It handles instrument connection, configuration, temperature readback, heater-range and setpoint control, temperature ramping, electrical measurement readout, and GUI creation, styling, logging, and UI state management.

records.name: MC1电机控制器
records.description: MC1是一种用于驱动和定位线性执行器的电机控制器，可设置步进增量、行程上下限，并执行居中、复位和定点移动等操作。在实验室中，它可用于对位置进行重复扫描与调整，常见于配合线性执行器进行Hong–Ou–Mandel（HOM）干涉谷测量等实验。
records.description_en: The MC1 is a motor controller used to drive and position a linear actuator. It supports step increment control, travel limits, centering, reset, and point-to-point motion. In the lab, it is used for repeatable position scanning and adjustment, such as operating a linear actuator for Hong–Ou–Mandel (HOM) dip measurements.
